content:
Starting today, iPhone users who have installed the Suno app can generate songs within the Messages app via text or voice prompts. Details are as follows.

Suno brings AI song generation to iMessage

Suno is one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, with over 2 million paid subscribers generating 7 million songs per day.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also offers an iPhone app that lets users create and remix AI songs via text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. The app also features user-created song series, editorial picks, and genre-categorized playlists.

Now, Suno users can also create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. After installing the Suno app, it will appear alongside other iMessage apps in the Messages app's app drawer, allowing users to generate songs via text prompts or voice messages without leaving the conversation.

Here's a live demo of the feature:

Suno says users can select a genre before generating a song, and regenerate multiple versions to pick their favorite before sending it to the chat conversation.

One potential limitation, according to Suno, is that both parties in the conversation need to have the app installed to use the feature. However, for users who love creating AI songs, downloading a free app shouldn't pose much of a hurdle.

Download Suno on the App Store.
